result.summary: The page is largely well-composed, but the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' hero card shows a loading spinner overlaid on an already-rendered image, indicating a stuck/incorrect loading state. There is also a stray dark rectangle artifact in that same illustration. Carousel edge clipping and the bottom card cut-off are expected behavior and excluded.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card displays a circular loading spinner centered on top of a fully loaded food image, suggesting the loading indicator never dismissed or the image state is out of sync.
issues.suggestion: Hide the spinner once the image has loaded (tie it to the image onLoad/state flag) and add a timeout/fallback so a persistent spinner cannot remain over rendered content.

issues.description: A solid dark-green rectangle appears floating over the upper-right of the ramen bowl illustration, looking like a misplaced or unstyled graphic element rather than part of the artwork.
issues.suggestion: Verify the illustration asset layers; remove or correctly position/round the stray shape so it reads as intentional (e.g., a nori sheet) rather than a rendering artifact.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' cards show only name and delivery fee with no rating or cuisine metadata, while 'Popular right now' cards include them, creating inconsistent information density between sections.
issues.suggestion: If intentional, keep it; otherwise align card metadata (rating, time, cuisine) across sections for a consistent scanning experience.
